key_insight: Overparameterized two-qubit quantum neural networks can exhibit grokking and epoch-wise double descent, and a weak weight-norm regularizer helps lock in late-stage generalization.
engineering_relevance: For quantum ML practitioners, circuit depth and regularization are practical knobs that can improve generalization stability in variational quantum models.
method: Complete SU(4) parameterization of a two-qubit QNN
Train overparameterized circuits while tracking train/test loss across epochs
Add weak explicit weight-norm regularization to reduce late-stage generalization decay
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical tests showing epoch-wise double descent, delayed grokking, and improved generalization probability with increased circuit depth, plus recovery under weight-norm regularization.
watch_item: The results are empirical on a small two-qubit setup, so the behavior may not transfer directly to larger or hardware-noisy quantum circuits without further validation.
paper_title: Grokking and epoch-wise double descent in quantum neural networks
